title: Ory Kratos LoopZero wrapper values schema
description: Plan v1.2 T2.5 / D4 — fail-fast on missing keys per ADR. Schema enforces uiBaseUrl pattern (no trailing slash per EC-8) and required-by-env override discipline. Extended by plan 2026-05-29-dashboard-public-integration-canonicalization T2.1 with public-URL keys for the dashboard public flow.

uiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Kratos UI redirects (login, registration, etc.). Anchored pattern: scheme http(s), FQDN-like host ([a-z0-9.-] starting with alnum), optional :NNNN numeric port. NO trailing slash (EC-8), NO query/fragment, NO userinfo (catches http://user:pass@host injection), NO non-numeric port (catches http://host:abc). Per env: dev/standalone/standalone-multi=http://localhost:4455; drill=https://app.drill.getloopscale.com; prod=https://app.getloopscale.com. Set via infra/helmfile/environments/<env>.yaml. (2026-05-20 pattern audit closed shadow bug class: old pattern '^https?://[^/]+(:[0-9]+)?\$' was too permissive — '[^/]+' greedy-matched any non-slash sequence including :abc, ?query, @userinfo.)

publicAuthUrl.description: Public Kratos hostname (browser-facing). When set, Kratos serve.public.base_url uses this, CORS is enabled, and session cookies scope to cookieDomain. T2.1 of plan 2026-05-29-dashboard-public-integration-canonicalization. v1.1 EC-07: env yamls MUST omit this key (not set it to empty) when not applicable — Go template default-fallback semantics require absence, not empty string.

cookieDomain.description: eTLD+1 for session cookie scope (e.g., getloopscale.com). Must be a parent of every host that consumes the cookie (app/cloud/auth subdomains all share it). When unset (local dev), Kratos defaults to the request host. v1.1 EC-D2: legacy leading dot not required for modern browsers.

corsAllowedOrigins.description: Origins permitted for cross-origin XHR from the dashboard. Required (non-empty) when publicAuthUrl is set — see dependencies. v1.1 EC-06: CORS with empty allowed_origins silently 403s every browser request.

allowedReturnUrls.description: Prefixes Kratos accepts in ?return_to= callback URLs. Should include {publicAuthUrl, publicCloudUrl, uiBaseUrl} and their trailing-slash variants.

dashboardRoute.description: Per-flow path mapping for the React dashboard (cloud/dashboard/src/app.tsx). Defaults baked into chart template via sprig `dig`. Override only when dashboard routes diverge — e.g., a future i18n setup serving /pt/login. Without this map, the 2026-05-29 LIVE bug recurs: Kratos generates /registration but the React route is /register → 404 on signup.

kratos.description: Upstream ory/kratos chart values pass-through. Schema does not constrain (delegates to upstream chart's own schema).

publicAuthUrl.description: v1.1 EC-06: setting publicAuthUrl without corsAllowedOrigins and cookieDomain produces a Kratos config that 403s every browser request and breaks session cross-host. Schema rejects partial configs to fail at helmfile lint time, not at LIVE login.
